integrity_notes: Two standard-library exact programs reconstruct finite certificates from definitions and an independent structural classification. No external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The first-mobile cutoff applies only to nondegenerate rectangular rook graphs of at most 24 cells.
The result is not an infinite-family classification of all double-total-domination exchanges.
Historical uniqueness against unindexed prior enumerations has not been independently certified.
title: The first movable minimum double-total domination configurations in rook graphs
